_note: Committed BEFORE opening .key.json. Sheets: progress/gauntlet/w11/blind2-desktop (fresh live Oryzo capture 27 Aug 2026 + settled-scroll capture of our build).
_honesty: I can identify both sites on sight; a coaster render and a navy/cream civic site are not confusable. The blinding here buys ordering discipline (picks fixed before the key is opened), not naivety. This is stated so nobody reads the result as a naive-observer test.

pacing.why: every frame of the winner is loaded; the loser runs two near-empty frames back to back at the 60-80% mark (pairs 06 and 08)

whitespace.why: margin used as structure - cream field, ranged-right measure, one rule; the loser's empty areas are render falloff around a floating object

type_restraint.why: two families, four sizes, one accent, held across ten frames; loser runs grotesque display + serif magazine pastiche + monospace annotation + handwriting

motion.why: loser's frames differ mainly by scroll offset; its one pinned scene spends most of a page-height to deliver a handful of words and closes on an empty frame

information_density.why: one frame carries four named partners, four domains and four one-line claims, all legible; the loser carries one gag per screen

one_glance_comprehension.why: first screen states what the organisation is and names its four 2026 pilots inside the fold; loser's first screen states a product name
